Imports flights from a CSV (text/csv body), all or nothing; a dry run by default (FLIGHT_WRITE)
post.description: Columns: flightNumber, airlineIataCode, originIataCode, destinationIataCode, departureTime, arrivalTime, seatClass, price, totalCapacity, aircraftType. At most 5000 lines. Every error comes back with its line. Send `dryRun=false` to write: it writes only if there are no errors (otherwise 422). A flight that already exists (same number and departure) is skipped, so sending the file twice is safe.

version.description: the version the editor read: if the flight changed since, it is a 409

destinationIataCode.description: the destination: an airport that serves the hotel

quantity.description: how many of this type the hotel has

bookingId.description: id of the caller's own CONFIRMED booking being reviewed

bookingIds.description: the caller's own PENDING bookings it would be applied to

items.description: the caller's own PENDING bookings it would be applied to

date.description: the travel date; not in the past

targetPrice.description: tell me when a flight costs at most this

bookingIds.description: ids of the caller's own PENDING bookings this payment covers — every leg of a trip at once

items.description: ids of the caller's own PENDING bookings this payment covers — every leg of a trip at once

cardLast4.description: last 4 digits of the card — the full number/CVV are never sent

promoCode.description: a promotional code, in any case; optional

token.description: the push token the device got from its platform

bookableId.description: id of an existing Bookable (e.g. a flight registered via POST /admin/flights)

seatId.description: id of an AVAILABLE Seat of that Bookable (see GET /bookables/{id}/seats)

query.example: voos baratos pra o Rio mês que vem

reason.example: lost the phone and the recovery codes

code.description: 3 to 32 letters, digits, '-' or '_'; kept in capitals

value.description: percent (below 100) or an amount of money

minAmount.description: the total must be at least this much

maxRedemptions.description: how many times in all; leave out for no limit

maxPerUser.description: how many times each customer; 1 if left out

airlineIataCode.description: IATA code, must exist in the airline table

originIataCode.description: IATA code, must exist in the airport table

destinationIataCode.description: IATA code, must exist in the airport table

aircraftType.description: Determines the real seat layout — see SeatLayout

reason.example: Erasure requested by the customer by e-mail

confirmation.description: the word ANONYMIZE and the customer id, exactly

body.example: Asked for a refund by phone; waiting for the airline

note.description: up to 500 characters; required with override
note.example: Customer called to cancel the trip

override.description: refund inside the last 24 hours before departure: SUPER_ADMIN only, with a note

challengeToken.description: Goes back, with the code, to /admin/auth/2fa/verify (or the enrollment endpoints)

enrollmentRequired.description: True when the account has no second factor yet and its role requires one

otpauthUri.description: For the QR code the authenticator app reads

manualEntryKey.description: The same secret, to type into the authenticator by hand

recoveryCodes.description: Shown this once: only their hashes are kept

items.description: Shown this once: only their hashes are kept

checkOut.description: the day the guests leave: not a night

rating.description: new rating from 1 to 5; leave out to keep the current one

comment.description: new comment; leave out to keep it
comment.example: Good, but the boarding was slow

targetPrice.description: a new target; leave out to keep it

active.description: switch the alert off or on; leave out to keep it

author.description: first name and the initial of the last one; never an e-mail or an id

average.description: average of the visible reviews, 1 to 5; null when there are none

additionalProperties.description: how many reviews gave each rating, keyed 1 to 5

distribution.description: how many reviews gave each rating, keyed 1 to 5

minSupportedVersion.description: the oldest app version still served: below it the app asks to update

storeUrl.description: where the user updates the app

fromPrice.description: the cheapest stay among the rooms that are free

totalPrice.description: what the whole stay costs in this room: nights x nightlyRate
